    The rotation is achieved using a fixed rotation matrix.

    """

    rotation_matrix = np.array([[0.707, -0.707], [0.707, 0.707]])

    # Elliptic function parameters: varying weights to one dimension
    weights = np.array([1.0, 5.0])
    scale_elliptic = 0.0005

    # Skewed trigonometric function parameters
    phase_shift = np.array([0.5, -0.2])
    scale_trig = 0.01  # Increasing this to raise fitness_std a bit

    # Linear component
    scale_lin = 0.005

    rotated_x = x @ rotation_matrix
